verdict.rationale: Zamzar's docs describe a dedicated sandbox environment at `https://sandbox.zamzar.com/`, separate from the production endpoint `https://api.zamzar.com/`, with all examples pointed at the sandbox. Pricing also offers free testing with no card required. Missing for 10: documentation of sandbox behavior, limits and data isolation from production, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the sandbox works as described.
